events.description: A light-colored SUV loses control on a wet/slippery road, rolls onto its side, and slides across the intersection, coming to rest on its roof. The vehicle appears to have collided with another car (dark sedan) just before or during the rollover.

After the SUV comes to rest on its side/roof, a person (likely the driver) exits the vehicle and is seen lying or slumped on the ground near the rear of the overturned SUV in frame f5; by f6, a figure in dark clothing approaches and appears to strike or push the prone individual, who then moves away. This suggests an attack on a helpless victim immediately after the crash.
A silver sedan (visible on the right) collides with the rear of a white van or minibus ahead of it, causing visible deformation and debris scattering on the road surface.
A black SUV loses control at an intersection, swerves sharply right, and collides with a stationary or slow-moving dark vehicle on the right side of the road, kicking up dust/debris.

A black SUV (likely a Lada 4x4 or similar) enters the intersection from the right and collides with a dark sedan traveling straight across the intersection, causing a visible dust cloud and abrupt change in vehicle trajectories.

A rear-end collision occurs on a multi-lane highway: a black sedan (license plate ending in '859') strikes the rear of an orange SUV, causing immediate deformation and debris. The impact forces the orange SUV forward and initiates a secondary collision with the vehicle ahead.

Following the initial impact, the black sedan is violently pushed sideways and collides with a silver sedan in the adjacent lane, resulting in significant side-impact damage and ejection of debris and dust.

In an urban intersection, a green minivan makes an illegal left turn across traffic and collides with a silver sedan traveling straight in the opposite direction; both vehicles are visibly displaced upon impact.
A red sedan collides with a black sedan at an intersection; the black car is struck on its driver's side, causing it to rotate and come to rest angled across the lane.

After the initial collision, debris is visible on the road and the red car continues moving slightly forward while the black car remains stationary in an abnormal position, indicating the aftermath of the crash.
A group of people gathers around the black car; individuals appear to be physically confronting each other near the open driver’s door, with pushing and close contact observed.

A dark sedan is stopped in the intersection with its driver-side door open; a red car is positioned at an angle nearby, suggesting a recent collision. Pedestrians are gathering around the vehicles, indicating an incident has just occurred.

A blue sedan collides with a dark sedan (likely a Lada) from the left side while both are moving through an intersection. The impact causes visible deformation on the blue car’s front-right side and pushes the dark sedan sideways.
A blue sedan collides with the rear of a dark-colored sedan at an intersection; the impact causes visible deformation and abrupt deceleration of the blue car.
